summary: FastAPI backend live: 8 routers (auth, signals, incidents, resources, dispatch, alerts, scenarios, trace_ws), SQLite schema with audit log, WebSocket artifact stream, OpenAPI 3 valid. End-to-end scenario run via REST works and surfaces results through /incidents.
lessons: Threading FastAPI app.state for store + bus + artifact_root keeps routers stateless and testable.
TestClient + lifespan handles DB seed transparently — no extra fixtures needed.
